summary: Newsroom work now ships once per milestone: every issue is completed first, then one merge, one release and one deploy. This release also applies security updates to Symfony and follow-redirects.
detailed_changes: Added a Cursor rule that applies milestone shipping in every session: all of a milestone's issues are completed first, then one merge commit to main, one release and one deploy, with hotfixes only on Bambie's written approval (#728).

Added AGENTS.md with the milestone shipping stages and the new definition of done: an issue is done when committed on its branch, and a milestone is done only after its merge, release and deploy (#730).
Added CONTRIBUTING.md with a short "How work ships" guide for contributors (#731).
Reviewed the release and deploy workflows: nothing tags, releases or deploys on merge, so no workflow changes were needed (#732).
Applied security updates: Symfony HTTP Foundation, HTTP Kernel, Routing and Serializer to 8.1.11, and follow-redirects to 1.16.2 (#735).
affected_areas: User groups affected: maintainers and AI coding agents
Internal impact: contributor and agent documentation, Cursor rules, PHP and JavaScript dependency patches
